from inventory import Inventory


def test_add_and_total():
    inv = Inventory()
    inv.add("apple", 3, 0.5)
    inv.add("apple", 2, 0.5)
    assert inv.total_value() == 2.5


def test_remove_exceeds_stock():
    inv = Inventory()
    inv.add("apple", 3, 0.5)
    try:
        inv.remove("apple", 5)
    except ValueError as e:
        assert str(e) == "Cannot remove 5 of apple, only 3 available"
    else:
        assert False


def test_get():

    item = inv.get("apple")

    assert item.name == "apple"
    assert item.quantity == 3
    assert item.price == 0.5
